intervals.label: no NuMI beam (Main Injector transformer failures)
intervals.note: Derived from the beam source: NuMI, the only beam NOvA uses, has not run since July 2024 (see beamline:numi). Restart is a plan, not a report: the PAC report of the April 2026 meeting (posted June 2026) says "A 20 week run is planned from October 2026 to Feb 2027 to run NuMI. The long shutdown is planned for 2028-29." It adds that the repaired transformers were due by 15 September, two weeks before the 1 October NuMI start. No source dated after July 2026 was found that confirms the restart, so the shutdown is left in place at 2026-10-25 and should be re-checked. The rest of the complex (Linac, Booster, Booster Neutrino Beam) kept running.
intervals.quote: Following the record achievement, the Main Injector complex suffered a series of failures that have prevented NuMI beam.

physics_goals.quote: Can we observe the oscillation of muon neutrinos to electron neutrinos?

physics_goals.quote: What is the ordering of the neutrino masses?
physics_goals.value: Determine the ordering of the neutrino masses (mass hierarchy)

physics_goals.quote: What is the symmetry between matter and antimatter?
physics_goals.value: Search for a matter–antimatter (CP-violating) asymmetry by comparing neutrino and antineutrino oscillations

summary.plain: A long-distance neutrino experiment: Fermilab fires a beam of neutrinos 810 kilometres through the Earth to northern Minnesota, watching how they change type on the way to learn about neutrino masses and matter-antimatter asymmetry.
summary.technical: Off-axis NuMI accelerator neutrino oscillation experiment with functionally identical near (0.3 kt, Fermilab) and far (14 kt, Ash River, MN) liquid-scintillator tracking calorimeters, 810 km baseline, 14.6 mrad off-axis, peak beam energy 1.8 GeV. Took first long-distance neutrinos in November 2013, began physics data in February 2014 and antineutrino-mode running in February 2017.

unique_capabilities.quote: Charged particle tracking is accomplished via PVC cells filled with a mineral oil-based liquid scintillator.
unique_capabilities.value: Two functionally identical liquid-scintillator tracking-calorimeter detectors on the same off-axis beam line, allowing many systematic uncertainties to cancel between near and far measurements
